title: Ultraviolet ink pass
description: A fluorescent underprint appears beneath a movable ultraviolet lens on an original event pass.
useCase: Let people inspect a hidden print layer, material finish or registered alternate state without losing the original object.
interaction: Move over the pass, drag the inspection lens, or reveal all the ink
reducedMotion: Inspection follows pointer and keyboard input immediately, without inertia or automatic motion. Control color transitions are removed.
limitations: Two independently authored SVG print layers and a feathered CSS mask; a visual ink demonstration, not fluorescence simulation, ticket validation or a security feature. No images, canvas or idle animation loop.
look: Dark charcoal page holding an orange notched ticket set in heavy dark-brown sans; a round lens shows a navy underprint with mint guilloche lines.
motion: A 136 px lens follows the pointer or drag directly, unmasking the ultraviolet layer through a feathered radial gradient; arrow keys step it and a toggle reveals everything.
adapt: The reveal is the `.sf-uv-hidden` layer's `maskImage` radial gradient centred on `point`, set by `locate`; tune its 62px/69px stops with the `.sf-uv-lens` size. Replace both `PassArtwork` variants (default and `ultraviolet`) with your base and hidden layers.
